captionBasis: Both Maryland forms extract clean text, so every caption claim here is checked against the printed page. The caption a field carries is the AcroForm field name Maryland authored, and `printedCaptionFound` records whether that exact string was found in the printed text of the page the widget sits on. Where it is false, Maryland abbreviates on the paper what it spells out in the field name ("Case No." against "Case Number"), and the printed line read at the widget's own coordinate is recorded beside it.
